ref: University Physics Volume 2, 11.3 Motion of a Charged Particle in a Magnetic Field
excerpt: The particle’s kinetic energy and speed thus remain constant.

reviewedMappings.2021-3-02:0: Perpendicular uniform field gives F=qvB; dividing by mass gives acceleration, not dividing by radius.
reviewedMappings.2021-3-02:1: F=ma and qvB=mv²/r imply a=qvB/m; N/m has wrong dimensions.
reviewedMappings.2021-3-02:2: Equation 11.6 gives T=2πr/v=2πm/(qB) in classical model.
reviewedMappings.2021-3-02:4: Line 31 states constant speed and kinetic energy due to zero magnetic work; classical kinetic energy mv²/2.
reviewedMappings.2021-3-02:5: Line 34 gives magnetic force qvB for perpendicular incidence.
